settlements.reason_short: Loss covered under ICC(A) all-risks (PingAn policy PA-MAR-CN-2026-04217, sum insured 110% = USD 26,400). USD 500 absolute deductible applied once per event. No commodity exclusion engaged for teak furniture water damage.

No damage observed on any of the 8 rubber gasket cartons (J01-J08, top tier front, all dry per surveyor). No payable claim under Allianz ICC(B) policy AL-DE-MAR-2026-008842; no FOB-side insurance event to settle.

Cotton-linen blend garments fall within Sinosure SC-NFT-2024-Rev3 natural-fibre textile moisture exclusion rider, which overrides ICC(A). Surveyor's no-gross-negligence finding means the override condition is not satisfied. Escalation path: commission an independent surveyor's report specifically addressing gross negligence of the carrier — if obtained, the 26,100 claim could be revisited.

Ordinary water damage in transit is not within the ICC(C) named-perils list (BaoViet BV-MAR-2026-VN-117344, narrowest of the three ICC tiers). No vessel grounding / sinking / capsizing / collision / jettison engaged. Would have been covered under ICC(B) had OceanTech elected the wider clause at policy inception. No coverage under the policy as written; no further surveyor evidence can cure the scope gap.

Mapfre MF-CL-MAR-2026-09812 ICC(A) covers the loss; no deductible applies (primer-comprador programme). However, clause MF-SUB-2025-08 caps the per-event aggregate at USD 2,000 — the single insurable event (water-ingress in container OCEAN-2026-04-V552) reduces the 7,200 gross claim to a 2,000 payout. Reduction = 5,200 capped.
